name: Odile Direct
description: Reach a business that has no API by its phone number. find_business_agent looks a participating business up (free); send_to_business leaves it a message, checks open times, or books or cancels a time. The tools list and lookups need no sign-in. Each agent identity gets 50 free tasks a month; after that a delivered message costs 1 credit ($0.10) and a confirmed booking 5 credits, paid with prepaid credits or per task with x402.
